programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Street Food Asia

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Street Food Asia
programme.desc: Luke continues his street food adventure exploring Jakarta, Indonesia. Meeting up with his old friend, Derice, Luke unearths the delicious delicacies of Chinatown, finding the experience a melting pot of diverse cultural cuisines. Luke joins the locals beneath the tall city skyscapers and uncovers a truly authentic Indonesian stall which serves every part of a chicken. During the busy lunch break Luke joins the hustle and bustle, meeting local Hadi, and dines on a diverse range of dishes. Moving onto dessert, Luke visits a vendor selling a sweet snack that resembles his grandmother’s hair.

programme.title: Planet Bbq
programme.desc: The meeting of East and West has profoundly influenced how we cook and eat. This show takes fusion cuisine to the grill. On the menu? 'Good Luck Cluck' (barbecued chicken with Thai curry), Lone Star Kalbi, and a grilled Pork and Cactus Salad bursting with Thai flavours.

programme.title: Project Fire
programme.desc: From its humble origins as a picnic served from the back of a buckboard wagon to today's high-tech, high-octane outdoor foodie extravaganzas, tailgating continues to enthral American sports fans.

programme.title: Freshly Picked
programme.desc: Today Simon makes a mouthwatering salad and home-style Chiko rolls. He then heads to Murray River to create three stunning dishes topped with good quality salt. Monica Mignone returns to the kitchen and makes an Aussie classic - ANZAC biscuits.

programme.title: Food Safari Water
programme.desc: Cooking fish over fire is an instant call to the tastebuds, a combination of two of the most pure elements on earth that together take seafood to the next level. Chef Lennox Hastie (Firedoor) cooks only over fire and takes his grill to a NSW south coast beach to cook a perfect whole flathead over coals, serving with broccolini and an ingenious pil pil sauce learnt from his days cooking in Spain’s Basque country.

programme.title: The Chocolate Queen
programme.desc: Dive into more chocolatey delights in this episode of The Chocolate Queen, as Kirsten Tibballs sweetens things up with a creamy white chocolate and rhubarb rice pudding.

programme.title: Street Food Nomad: Kolkata
programme.desc: In Kolkata street food isn't only about the hawker stalls. Coffee Houses are part meeting place, part restaurant, part community hall, serving up quick and simple food for the multitudes.

programme.title: Nigellissima
programme.desc: Nigella Lawson's mission to show how easy it is to bring the spirit of Italy into the kitchen continues as she shares the secrets of her celebratory, yet simple, Italian roast chicken, served alongside a sunny saffron orzotto. Dessert comes courtesy of Nigella's surprisingly easy coffee ice cream, inspired by lazy days spent in the ice cream parlours of Florence, and an extra treat is presented in the form of a chocolate olive oil cake.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Taste Of Italian Opera
programme.desc: In this colourful special, top chef Rick Stein takes a lighthearted look at the role that food played in the creation of Italian opera and shows how music and food are intrinsically linked in Italy. He draws parallels between cooking and composing, noting how both involve the skilful combination of ingredients and how they share the common purpose of bringing pleasure to many and lifting the human spirit. Rick also explains why he thinks the music of three great Italian composers - Verdi and Rossini - is connected to the food of the regions where they lived and worked.

programme.desc: Having retrieved the key to Harry's strong box, Frankie finally has access to money. Gwen and Esther are amazed to finally receive an income in exchange for their labour. Just like a man! Normally Harry's domain, Frankie doles out the wages instead, and for the first time, Kathleen receives her payment alongside the others. Seeing her paid in rations and a handful of coins highlights the vast inequalities between them, and makes everyone deeply uncomfortable.

programme.title: While The Men Are Away
programme.desc: Esther has uncovered a dead body in the freshly ploughed field and tells Gwen. They're interrupted by Frankie and Kathleen who admit the corpse is Harry - they hid his death in a farming accident in order to keep possession of the farm. Given that Australia is at war with Italy, Frankie is currently an enemy of the Empire and the farm would go to Harry's insufferable brother, Des. Harry's death also meant Kathleen was at risk of being shipped away for work.

Surrounded by relatives, the kids innocently reveal the ins and outs of their family life and many intimate details about their parents. It's soon clear that when it comes to keeping a big secret under wraps from the rest of the family, their children are their biggest liability. Stars David Tennant and Rosamund Pike.

Hardy and is invited to attend Trinity College, Cambridge. Directed by Matthew Brown and stars Dev Patel, Jeremy Irons and Toby Jones.

Directed by John Tatoulis and stars Russell Crowe and Caroline Goodall.

But when he supports a child with Communist parents, he also gets wrongly accused. Directed by and starring Charlie Chaplin. Also stars Maxine Audley and Jerry Desmonde.

programme.title: The Lady And The Highwayman
programme.desc: During one of his robberies, a highwayman, who steals from the rich and gives to the poor, falls in love with an aristocratic lady. Now, he is forced to choose between his true love or his true cause.

programme.title: The Great Escaper

programme.title: The Beautiful Summer
programme.desc: Turin, 1938. Young Ginia has just moved from the countryside and the future seems to offer her endless possibilities. Desperate for adventure, Ginia begins an electric affair with a painter she meets in the dazzling artists world. The woman who leads her into the bohemian quarters is Amelia. Sensual and provocative, Amelia is not much older than Ginia, but different from anyone she has ever met and ready to shake her certainties. During her “beautiful summer”, Ginia will surrender to her first great love. She will finally give in to her overwhelming feelings, celebrating the courage to be truly herself.

At midday a baguette tucked under the arm signals lunch. And by the afternoon, the ritual if le gouter arrives, where mouthwatering sweet treats are savoured like miniature works of art. Resistance is futile and Eva is seduced by the Paris Brest, a rum baba, the macaron, a mango cake and dahlia to name just a few.

programme.title: Two Tickets To Greece
programme.desc: Recently divorced, and watching helplessly as her only son leaves home, Blandine is struggling to find her footing again. So when her former best friend Magalie, loud and fearless, suddenly resurfaces, she allows herself to be spontaneous for a change.

programme.title: What We Did On Our Holiday
programme.desc: Doug and Abi take their kids on a family holiday. Surrounded by relatives, the kids innocently reveal the ins and outs of their family life and many intimate details about their parents. It's soon clear that when it comes to keeping a big secret under wraps from the rest of the family, their children are their biggest liability. Stars David Tennant and Rosamund Pike.

programme.title: Discovering Film

Hardy and is invited to attend Trinity College, Cambridge. Directed by Matthew Brown and stars Dev Patel, Jeremy Irons and Toby Jones.

programme.title: Strangeness

programme.title: The Silver Brumby
programme.desc: During a violent storm in the Victorian Highlands, a mother tells her frightened daughter a fable about a great silver brumby who must find its place among its kind, while one man, living in the wilderness, is determined to capture the brumby and tame it. Directed by John Tatoulis and stars Russell Crowe and Caroline Goodall.

programme.title: The Grass Harp
programme.desc: After his mother's death, Collin moves in with two eccentric cousins-stern Verena and gentle Dolly. When Verena tries to sell Dolly's secret tonic, a wild rebellion sparks, leading to a heartwarming showdown.

programme.title: A King In New York
programme.desc: A recently-deposed European monarch from a fictional country seeks shelter in New York City where he becomes an accidental television celebrity. But when he supports a child with Communist parents, he also gets wrongly accused. Directed by and starring Charlie Chaplin. Also stars Maxine Audley and Jerry Desmonde.

programme.title: The Lady And The Highwayman
programme.desc: During one of his robberies, a highwayman, who steals from the rich and gives to the poor, falls in love with an aristocratic lady. Now, he is forced to choose between his true love or his true cause.

programme.title: The Great Escaper
programme.desc: Bernard Jordan escapes his care home to attend the D-Day anniversary in Normandy, a journey that reveals wartime trauma and celebrates his 60-year marriage to Rene and enduring love.

programme.title: The Beautiful Summer
programme.desc: Turin, 1938. Young Ginia has just moved from the countryside and the future seems to offer her endless possibilities. Desperate for adventure, Ginia begins an electric affair with a painter she meets in the dazzling artists world. The woman who leads her into the bohemian quarters is Amelia. Sensual and provocative, Amelia is not much older than Ginia, but different from anyone she has ever met and ready to shake her certainties. During her “beautiful summer”, Ginia will surrender to her first great love. She will finally give in to her overwhelming feelings, celebrating the courage to be truly herself.

programme.title: How To Get Ahead In Advertising

At midday a baguette tucked under the arm signals lunch. And by the afternoon, the ritual if le gouter arrives, where mouthwatering sweet treats are savoured like miniature works of art. Resistance is futile and Eva is seduced by the Paris Brest, a rum baba, the macaron, a mango cake and dahlia to name just a few.

programme.desc: Cooking fish over fire is an instant call to the tastebuds, a combination of two of the most pure elements on earth that together take seafood to the next level. programme.title: Nigellissima
programme.desc: Nigella Lawson's mission to show how easy it is to bring the spirit of Italy into the kitchen continues as she shares the secrets of her celebratory, yet simple, Italian roast chicken, served alongside a sunny saffron orzotto. Dessert comes courtesy of Nigella's surprisingly easy coffee ice cream, inspired by lazy days spent in the ice cream parlours of Florence, and an extra treat is presented in the form of a chocolate olive oil cake.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Taste Of Italian Opera
programme.desc: In this colourful special, top chef Rick Stein takes a lighthearted look at the role that food played in the creation of Italian opera and shows how music and food are intrinsically linked in Italy. He draws parallels between cooking and composing, noting how both involve the skilful combination of ingredients and how they share the common purpose of bringing pleasure to many and lifting the human spirit. Rick also explains why he thinks the music of three great Italian composers - Verdi and Rossini - is connected to the food of the regions where they lived and worked.

programme.title: While The Men Are Away
programme.sub-title: God Speed The Plough And The Woman Who Drives It!
programme.desc: Having retrieved the key to Harry's strong box, Frankie finally has access to money. Gwen and Esther are amazed to finally receive an income in exchange for their labour. Just like a man! Normally Harry's domain, Frankie doles out the wages instead, and for the first time, Kathleen receives her payment alongside the others. Seeing her paid in rations and a handful of coins highlights the vast inequalities between them, and makes everyone deeply uncomfortable.

programme.title: While The Men Are Away
programme.desc: Esther has uncovered a dead body in the freshly ploughed field and tells Gwen. They're interrupted by Frankie and Kathleen who admit the corpse is Harry - they hid his death in a farming accident in order to keep possession of the farm. Given that Australia is at war with Italy, Frankie is currently an enemy of the Empire and the farm would go to Harry's insufferable brother, Des. Harry's death also meant Kathleen was at risk of being shipped away for work.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Taste Of Italian Opera
programme.desc: In this colourful special, top chef Rick Stein takes a lighthearted look at the role that food played in the creation of Italian opera and shows how music and food are intrinsically linked in Italy. Rick also explains why he thinks the music of three great Italian composers - Verdi and Rossini - is connected to the food of the regions where they lived and worked.

programme.title: The Chocolate Queen
programme.desc: It's a magical day in the Chocolate Queen kitchen as Kirsten Tibballs creates her sweet and cheeky mini chocolate frogs, perfect on their own.

programme.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
programme.desc: On today's show, Justine whips up some fun dishes using some sweet grapes, makes a beautiful Vegetarian Cauliflower Dip and is joined by Trish McKenzie to make a show stopping chocolate pudding.

programme.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
programme.desc: Tonight, Adam, Supermarket Swap founder Nabula El Mourid and Saturday Night Pasta founder Elizabeth Hewson are here to help you cook better and eat better.

programme.title: Hairy Bikers Mediterranean
programme.desc: The bikers visit Minorca and Majorca to discover evidence of British influence, great fresh fish and local produce, and to ride one of the most extraordinary roads in the world.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Street Food Asia
programme.desc: Luke continues unearthing different street foods in Kuala Lumpur, starting at the central Jalan Imbi market.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Street Food Asia
programme.desc: Luke continues his street food adventure exploring Jakarta, Indonesia. Meeting up with his old friend, Derice, Luke unearths the delicious delicacies of Chinatown, finding the experience a melting pot of diverse cultural cuisines. Luke joins the locals beneath the tall city skyscapers and uncovers a truly authentic Indonesian stall which serves every part of a chicken. During the busy lunch break Luke joins the hustle and bustle, meeting local Hadi, and dines on a diverse range of dishes. Moving onto dessert, Luke visits a vendor selling a sweet snack that resembles his grandmother’s hair.

programme.title: Planet Bbq
programme.desc: The meeting of East and West has profoundly influenced how we cook and eat. This show takes fusion cuisine to the grill. On the menu? 'Good Luck Cluck' (barbecued chicken with Thai curry), Lone Star Kalbi, and a grilled Pork and Cactus Salad bursting with Thai flavours.

programme.title: Project Fire
programme.desc: From its humble origins as a picnic served from the back of a buckboard wagon to today's high-tech, high-octane outdoor foodie extravaganzas, tailgating continues to enthral American sports fans.

programme.title: Kriol Kitchen
programme.sub-title: Deep Fried Mullet With Vegies, Fish Soup, Som Tum With Fried Mackerel And Blue Bone
programme.desc: Sitting high on the red cliffs at Whalesong is a beautiful little surprise-a Bush Restaurant run by Lenny O'Meara and his wife Jacinta.

programme.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes
programme.sub-title: Fried Shrimp Poppers And Deviled Popcorn
programme.desc: Rachael brings the party to her upstate kitchen with a fun and festive spread.

programme.title: My Market Kitchen
programme.desc: Mike starts with his warm Poached Chicken Salad, followed by his Poached Salmon and Pea Fish Cakes with Tahini and Yogurt Sauce.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Join Lidia at the table for some traditional winter fare of the northern Italian mountains.

programme.title: Taste Of Australia With Hayden Quinn
programme.desc: Hayden travels to Bruny Island, off the coast of Tasmania, to enjoy the surf before being introduced to beach foraging. He makes some amazing new friends and cooks for them with local produce.

programme.title: Freshly Picked
programme.desc: Today Simon makes a mouthwatering salad and home-style Chiko rolls. He then heads to Murray River to create three stunning dishes topped with good quality salt. Monica Mignone returns to the kitchen and makes an Aussie classic - ANZAC biscuits.

programme.title: Food Safari Water
programme.desc: Cooking fish over fire is an instant call to the tastebuds, a combination of two of the most pure elements on earth that together take seafood to the next level. Chef Lennox Hastie (Firedoor) cooks only over fire and takes his grill to a NSW south coast beach to cook a perfect whole flathead over coals, serving with broccolini and an ingenious pil pil sauce learnt from his days cooking in Spain’s Basque country.

programme.title: The Chocolate Queen
programme.desc: Dive into more chocolatey delights in this episode of The Chocolate Queen, as Kirsten Tibballs sweetens things up with a creamy white chocolate and rhubarb rice pudding.

programme.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
programme.desc: Justine shows you a healthy way to start the day with her green energy smoothie, she serves up some amazing Sicilian donuts stued with ricotta and whips up some bananas from the banks of the Murray River.

programme.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
programme.desc: Two top tier chefs, Will Houia and Vincent Lim, join Adam in the kitchen to prepare some fantastically flashy fish dishes.

programme.title: Street Food Nomad: Kolkata
programme.desc: In Kolkata street food isn't only about the hawker stalls. Coffee Houses are part meeting place, part restaurant, part community hall, serving up quick and simple food for the multitudes.

programme.title: Nigellissima
programme.desc: Nigella Lawson's mission to show how easy it is to bring the spirit of Italy into the kitchen continues as she shares the secrets of her celebratory, yet simple, Italian roast chicken, served alongside a sunny saffron orzotto. Dessert comes courtesy of Nigella's surprisingly easy coffee ice cream, inspired by lazy days spent in the ice cream parlours of Florence, and an extra treat is presented in the form of a chocolate olive oil cake.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Taste Of Italian Opera
programme.desc: In this colourful special, top chef Rick Stein takes a lighthearted look at the role that food played in the creation of Italian opera and shows how music and food are intrinsically linked in Italy. He draws parallels between cooking and composing, noting how both involve the skilful combination of ingredients and how they share the common purpose of bringing pleasure to many and lifting the human spirit. Rick also explains why he thinks the music of three great Italian composers - Verdi and Rossini - is connected to the food of the regions where they lived and worked.

programme.title: Come Dine With Me
programme.desc: It's the final night of the competition in Liverpool and last up is carpet and flooring specialist Chris, who's hoping his musically inspired nosh will send him to the top of the leaderboard.

programme.title: Hairy Bikers Mediterranean

programme.title: While The Men Are Away
programme.sub-title: God Speed The Plough And The Woman Who Drives It!
programme.desc: Having retrieved the key to Harry's strong box, Frankie finally has access to money. Gwen and Esther are amazed to finally receive an income in exchange for their labour. Just like a man! Normally Harry's domain, Frankie doles out the wages instead, and for the first time, Kathleen receives her payment alongside the others. Seeing her paid in rations and a handful of coins highlights the vast inequalities between them, and makes everyone deeply uncomfortable.

programme.title: While The Men Are Away
programme.desc: Esther has uncovered a dead body in the freshly ploughed field and tells Gwen. They're interrupted by Frankie and Kathleen who admit the corpse is Harry - they hid his death in a farming accident in order to keep possession of the farm. Given that Australia is at war with Italy, Frankie is currently an enemy of the Empire and the farm would go to Harry's insufferable brother, Des. Harry's death also meant Kathleen was at risk of being shipped away for work.

Meanwhile, having escaped her first attempt to kill him, Nicky is back on the hunt for Christian but she soon discovers that Christian is already one step ahead of her.

Meeting up with his old friend, Derice, Luke unearths the delicious delicacies of Chinatown, finding the experience a melting pot of diverse cultural cuisines. Luke joins the locals beneath the tall city skyscapers and uncovers a truly authentic Indonesian stall which serves every part of a chicken. During the busy lunch break Luke joins the hustle and bustle, meeting local Hadi, and dines on a diverse range of dishes. Moving onto dessert, Luke visits a vendor selling a sweet snack that resembles his grandmother’s hair.

programme.desc: Cooking fish over fire is an instant call to the tastebuds, a combination of two of the most pure elements on earth that together take seafood to the next level. programme.title: Nigellissima
programme.desc: Nigella Lawson's mission to show how easy it is to bring the spirit of Italy into the kitchen continues as she shares the secrets of her celebratory, yet simple, Italian roast chicken, served alongside a sunny saffron orzotto. Dessert comes courtesy of Nigella's surprisingly easy coffee ice cream, inspired by lazy days spent in the ice cream parlours of Florence, and an extra treat is presented in the form of a chocolate olive oil cake.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Taste Of Italian Opera
programme.desc: In this colourful special, top chef Rick Stein takes a lighthearted look at the role that food played in the creation of Italian opera and shows how music and food are intrinsically linked in Italy. He draws parallels between cooking and composing, noting how both involve the skilful combination of ingredients and how they share the common purpose of bringing pleasure to many and lifting the human spirit. Rick also explains why he thinks the music of three great Italian composers - Verdi and Rossini - is connected to the food of the regions where they lived and worked.

programme.desc: Having retrieved the key to Harry's strong box, Frankie finally has access to money. Gwen and Esther are amazed to finally receive an income in exchange for their labour. Just like a man! Normally Harry's domain, Frankie doles out the wages instead, and for the first time, Kathleen receives her payment alongside the others. Seeing her paid in rations and a handful of coins highlights the vast inequalities between them, and makes everyone deeply uncomfortable.

programme.title: While The Men Are Away

They're interrupted by Frankie and Kathleen who admit the corpse is Harry - they hid his death in a farming accident in order to keep possession of the farm. Given that Australia is at war with Italy, Frankie is currently an enemy of the Empire and the farm would go to Harry's insufferable brother, Des. Harry's death also meant Kathleen was at risk of being shipped away for work.
